distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Hyorrhynchus lewisi as occurring in Taiwan.

host_note: The source reports five host species distributed among Aceraceae, Cornaceae, Fagaceae and Ulmaceae, but does not name them in the extracted record. No host taxon is inferred beyond the source statement.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hyorrhynchus lewisi Blandford, 1894.

taxonomic_history.name: Hyorrhynchus lewisi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hyorrhynchus lewisi Blandford, 1894, VSN_3145. Beaver & Liu (2010) rejects earlier synonymy of H. drescheri and H. granulatus with H. lewisi.
